title: Seven Seals — Reverse Timeline, Creative Clues & Fulfillment Audit
purpose: Rebuild the Seven Seals from Revelation 5-8, then search backward through Tim-originated conversations, songs, art titles and dated project material for prior motifs. This does not presume literal fulfillment; it ranks timeline and specificity.

biblical_sequence.pattern: sealed scroll → no worthy opener → Lion of Judah / Root of David → slain-yet-standing Lamb → seven horns / seven eyes / seven Spirits → new song
biblical_sequence.note: This precondition is crucial: the Seven Seals belong to one scroll and are opened by the Lion/Root/Lamb figure.

biblical_sequence.pattern: white horse → bow → crown → goes out conquering / to conquer
red horse → peace removed → people kill one another → great sword
black horse → scales/balance → grain prices/scarcity → oil and wine spared
pale/green horse → rider Death → Hades follows → sword/famine/death/beasts
slain witnesses under altar → testimony → cry 'how long?' → white robes → waiting until completion
great earthquake → black sun → blood-like moon → falling stars → sky withdrawn → mountains/islands displaced → rulers hide → wrath of Lamb
silence in heaven about half an hour → seven angels receive trumpets → incense/prayers → fire cast to earth → thunder/rumbling/lightning/earthquake → trumpet sequence begins

historical_project_correction.resolution: Preserve as historical Potatoverse creative material only. It is not the biblical Seven Seals sequence and must not be used as evidence that Revelation's seven seals were already mapped correctly.

seal_by_seal_audit.why: Conquest/crown imagery is common and no recovered Tim-first white-horse + bow + crown sequence has yet been found.
War/conflict is too ubiquitous. Need a prior specific red/horse/sword/peace-removed cluster.
Seal 3 is unusually concrete: scales + grain prices + scarcity + oil/wine exception. Search should prioritize exact price/ration/balance imagery rather than general economics.
Death/underworld motifs are dense in Tim's corpus, but pale horse and quarter-earth judgment are missing.
Testimony + death + waiting/justice is more distinctive than generic war/death; Empty Church/prayer adds a pre-2026 creative clue.
Cosmic-disaster imagery is culturally common. Need dated prior specificity: earthquake + dark sun + blood moon + stars + sky/mountain movement together.
Silence + prayer/incense + threshold before a new sevenfold sequence is unusual. The 9 Nov 2025 art title 'Prayer in Empty Church' is worth visual recovery.

creative_evidence_method.song_rule: Use title/lyrics/publication timestamp as primary creative evidence. A song becomes a stronger prior-symbolic clue when its specific imagery predates a later event or interpretive framework.
creative_evidence_method.art_rule: Filename date/time and title are metadata clues; visual claims require the actual image. Do not infer depicted objects solely from a title.
